taglines: Monday arrived wearing a lanyard and holding a clipboard and everyone is pretending this is normal because civilization is mostly shared commitment to not yelling at furniture.
The calendar says July and the inbox says prosecution and the coffee says technically yes but spiritually you are a haunted spreadsheet with conditional formatting problems.
Some days the right answer is discipline and some days the right answer is committing one clean, elegant act of nonsense so the machinery remembers who owns the keys.
You can optimize the workflow again or you can admit the workflow is just a tiny office you built inside your head where all the employees are also you and none of them have benefits.
Today's vibe is knives out for vague obligations, flowers for specific joys, and a small procedural hearing for every thought that starts with 'I should probably'.
There is no prize for suffering silently through a bad process, only a second bad process called explaining why the first one ate the afternoon.
Be kind, be sharp, drink water, distrust meetings that generate more meetings, and never let a PDF with opinions make eye contact for too long.
The future is not arriving fully assembled; it is showing up in parts, missing two screws, and asking whether you still have the little hex key from last time.
